title: Famous people who learn differently
examples: Are there famous people who learn differently?
Can people like me do great things?

figure.name: x-sort
figure.question: They have said they learn differently

explain.say: Some famous people have said they learn in their own way. They found ways that help them. Look at the board. Here are 6 of them, sorted by their jobs.

draw.name: x-sort
draw.question: They have said they learn differently

explain.say: Look at the science group. Temple Grandin has written that she thinks in pictures. She became an animal scientist. She helped design farms that are calmer for animals. Greta Thunberg is from Sweden. She has said that being different can help her. Do you think in pictures?

draw.name: x-sort
draw.question: They have said they learn differently

explain.say: Now look at sport. Simone Biles is a gymnast from the United States. She has talked openly about how she learns and focuses. Michael Phelps is a swimmer. He has said sitting still at school was hard. He won 23 Olympic gold medals. What sport do you like?

draw.name: x-sort
draw.question: They have said they learn differently

explain.say: Look at the camera. Richard Branson has said reading at school was hard for him. Later, he started many businesses. Daniel Radcliffe played Harry Potter in the films. He has said handwriting and tying shoelaces were hard for him. Did any of these surprise you?

draw.name: x-sort
draw.question: They have said they learn differently

explain.say: These people found their own ways to learn. Every person matters, famous or unknown. You have your own strengths too. Today, find one more fact about one of these people with a grown-up.

faq.a: Temple Grandin is an American animal scientist. She has written that she thinks in pictures, and she helped design farms that are calmer for animals.
asks: Tell me about Science and nature

faq.a: Simone Biles is an American gymnast and one of the most successful gymnasts ever. She has spoken openly about how her brain works.
Richard Branson is a British businessman who started the Virgin companies. He has said that reading at school was hard for him.
asks: Tell me about Business and film

faq.a: People often say so, but there is no clear proof. Here, we only share what people have said about themselves.

faq.q: Can people who learn differently do great things?
faq.a: Yes. Many people who learn differently do great things in science, sport, art, business and more. Finding what helps you matters most. A grown-up you trust can help.

facts: Michael Phelps won 23 Olympic gold medals, more than anyone else in history.
Temple Grandin wrote a book called Thinking in Pictures, published in 1995.
Daniel Radcliffe played Harry Potter in eight films.

quiz.say: Which person has written that she thinks in pictures?
quiz.why: Temple Grandin wrote a book called Thinking in Pictures.

wrong.0: Michael Phelps is a swimmer who has said sitting still at school was hard.
wrong.1: Richard Branson has said reading at school was hard for him.

quiz.say: Reading at school was hard for Richard Branson. What did he do later?
quiz.show: Richard Branson found reading hard. What did he do later?
quiz.why: Richard Branson started many businesses, called the Virgin companies.

wrong.1: Daniel Radcliffe is the actor who played Harry Potter.
wrong.2: Michael Phelps is the swimmer who won Olympic gold medals.
